messages:
incident-bot: ALERT org=orchid.ai sustained QPS surge in us-west-2; 429s increasing. auto-org-throttle applied -> 50rps. paging on-call.
ryan: got it, joining. any customer-visible errors?
lina: support on a bridge with Orchid engineering — they report dashboard streams returning 429s and partial websocket disconnects for ~6m.
julia: metrics show token qps ~3.8x baseline, error-rate (429) spiking to 18%. origin looks like a retry-heavy batch client from a single customer IP range.
aman: can we do a scoped mitigation instead of full-account unblock? options: short QPS bump + client-side backoff enforcement + disable non-essential enrichments (avatar/image_enrichment).
ryan: need AM ok for temporary bump. Simon, can you confirm?
simon: AM looped in, customer on standard contract — approve emergency +120rps for 25m while we stabilize. flag for billing review afterwards.
julia: plan: (1) apply org temp +120rps for 25m, (2) enable per-client 1s token backoff/dedup window for identical requests, (3) flip off image_enrichment and avatar_processing for orchid.ai, (4) soft-queue smoothing. If still unhealthy, escalate to full traffic circuit-break.
aman: commands ready:
```
# apply temporary org bump
/redwood rate-adjust --org orchid.ai --add 120 --duration 25m --note "INC-2026-0317-orchid"
# enable per-client dedupe & backoff
/redwood client-policy --org orchid.ai --set dedupe_window=45s --set max_retry_rate=2rps
# toggle features
/redwood feature-toggle --org orchid.ai --feature image_enrichment --disable --note "incident mitigation"
/redwood feature-toggle --org orchid.ai --feature avatar_processing --disable --note "incident mitigation"
```
ryan: execute when ready, I'll stay on bridge and keep customer updated.
ops-bot: rate-adjust executed by aman: orchid.ai +120rps (expires in 25m). New org limit: 170rps. Client-policy & dedupe enabled for orchid.ai.
ops-bot: feature-toggle executed: image_enrichment disabled for orchid.ai.
ops-bot: feature-toggle executed: avatar_processing disabled for orchid.ai.
lina: customer confirms 429s dropped substantially within ~90s, dashboards resyncing. they see some features missing but core streams resumed. :white_check_mark:
aman: seeing one persistent heavy client (same IP) still spamming short retries; applying a client-specific soft-block and instructing to backoff.
julia: enabled soft-queue for orchid.ai to smooth bursts. monitoring shows 429s down to 2-3% and latency stable.
ryan: handing off to next on-call at +40m. keep me on the bridge until handoff complete.
simon: billing noted; will review for potential credits in postmortem.
lina: closing immediate customer loop with summary + expected rollback timeline.
ops-bot: Scheduled rollback: org rate-adjust expire in 25m; features remain disabled until manual sign-off.
julia: opening incident ticket INC-2026-0317-orchid for postmortem. action items: reproduce retry pattern, harden client-policy docs, consider auto-detect per-client storm mitigation.
incident-bot: Incident state=stabilized; last_action_ts=2950012678; channel=#incidents; ticket=INC-2026-0317-orchid."
